problem: Questionnaire-oriented fields do not adequately describe task learning, trial/block structure, payoff schedules, software/version or model-dependent outputs.
proposed_fields_or_change: Add task-specific specification fields: trial_count; block_structure; payoff/reward_structure; implementation/software/version; canonical_output(s); practice/learning_effects; task_variant/adaptation note.
why_deferred: Current P1C-B fields were sufficient for evidence extraction; expanding schema mid-calibration would create churn before other archetypes are tested.
trigger_for_revisit: Website V3 vertical-slice build after calibration across all five approaches.
note: Do not retrofit production extraction until Website V3 adjudication confirms which fields are genuinely useful.

problem: A single default public variant is misleading for editioned frameworks such as DSM; DSM-IV is currently the derived default while DSM-5 is the evidence anchor.
proposed_fields_or_change: Use an edition-neutral family landing. Show editions explicitly with status/date and evidence coverage; maintain a separate evidence_anchor rather than a universal default edition.
why_deferred: Current exact-edition evidence is correctly separated; product navigation, not scientific identity, is the problem.
note: Do not transfer evidence across DSM editions.

problem: Questionnaire-style score fields do not describe a clinical multi-domain assessment such as NICE NG248.
proposed_fields_or_change: Add fields for domains/components; assessor/discipline; training/competence; formulation/output; care/safety-planning outputs; time/resources; referral/coordination requirements; implementation resources.
why_deferred: Extraction succeeded without forcing psychometrics; final public page needs type-specific specification.
note: Keep direct procedure evidence separate from evidence for component tools.

problem: Interview families can contain clinician-administered, self-report, computerised and translated/adapted forms with different evidence.
proposed_fields_or_change: Expose administration/form relationship metadata and exact release/module/diagnostic-edition fields on assessment pages.
why_deferred: Exact-form/context-only attribution works in P1C-B; this is primarily a public presentation/refinement need.
note: Do not create new canonical forms opportunistically during evidence review.

problem: Non-empirical implementation/audit resources were being represented as application examples.
proposed_fields_or_change: Separate empirical APPLICATION_EXAMPLES from IMPLEMENTATION_RESOURCES; show both publicly where useful but do not combine their counts.
why_deferred: Implemented in CAL-A-01 closure workbook before production.
trigger_for_revisit: Immediate; retained for Website V3 display design.
note: NICE audit/action-planning resource is the first implementation-resource record.

problem: Reconstruction procedures are currently compressed into free-text exact-form descriptions.
proposed_fields_or_change: Add a method specification block for recall/reference window, temporal/event aids, reconstructed units, inputs/outputs and aggregation.
why_deferred: Evidence extraction already retains the details; presentation/comparison needs structure.
trigger_for_revisit: Website V3 / schema-freeze after all approach calibration.

problem: Analytical outputs with different causal meaning can look equivalent if estimand/counterfactual/economic assumptions are not explicit.
proposed_fields_or_change: Add estimand/output, causal status, counterfactual/reference, risk/exposure inputs, perspective, price year/currency, horizon, valuation, uncertainty and double-counting fields.
why_deferred: Construct mapping remains valid; this is interpretation/configuration structure.
trigger_for_revisit: Website V3 / schema-freeze after all approach calibration.

problem: A VAS is only interpretable when its exact prompt, anchors, format/interface and transformation are known.
why_deferred: Keeps CONFIGURABLE methods searchable without inheriting constructs from applications.
trigger_for_revisit: Website V3 / schema-freeze after all approach calibration.

problem: Package-level pages need to show which form/component/version/time point each evidence claim concerns.
proposed_fields_or_change: Add a component × version × time-point manifest and component-specific evidence display.
trigger_for_revisit: Website V3 / schema-freeze after all approach calibration.

problem: SNA is construct-defined but heavily configuration-dependent; existing page fields do not expose network design choices.
proposed_fields_or_change: Add relational specification fields for actors/boundaries/ties/time/missingness/metrics/implementation; keep C1903 Social-network structure as the construct.
why_deferred: Separates what the method measures from how a particular network is specified.
trigger_for_revisit: Website V3 / schema-freeze after all approach calibration.

problem: Financial quantities are not comparable without explicit accounting conventions.
proposed_fields_or_change: Add financial-indicator accounting manifest: exact formula/estimand, sign, window, units/currency, source coverage and transaction adjustments.
why_deferred: Current evidence extraction retains details but public comparison needs enforceable structure.
trigger_for_revisit: Website V3 / schema freeze after all approach calibration.

problem: Service rates can change materially with denominator, episode and exit definitions.
trigger_for_revisit: Website V3 / schema freeze after all approach calibration.

problem: Transactional indicators depend on account coverage, merchant classification and processing rules; gross outflow and net deposits are distinct.
proposed_fields_or_change: Add transactional coverage/classification manifest and explicit estimand label.
why_deferred: P1C-A v1.3 resolves the merchant-outflow provenance conflict; public display still needs structured metadata.
trigger_for_revisit: Website V3 / schema freeze after all approach calibration.

problem: Area indicators are edition/geography dependent and easily misread as individual-level attributes.
proposed_fields_or_change: Add edition, geography, lookup/remapping, grouping/aggregation and ecological-interpretation metadata.
why_deferred: Supports reproducible linkage and cross-version interpretation.
trigger_for_revisit: Website V3 / schema freeze after all approach calibration.

problem: A QALY result is uninterpretable without utility/value-set, time, comparator and modelling assumptions.
proposed_fields_or_change: Add health-economic metric specification block for utility inputs, schedule/interpolation, survival, output/sign, horizon/discounting and observed/modelled status.
why_deferred: Keeps the generic QALY metric separate from the instrument/value set that supplies utility.
trigger_for_revisit: Website V3 / schema freeze after all approach calibration.

problem: The locked MSC object is recovery-labelled, but calibration identified generic MSC methodology rather than a standardised gambling-recovery procedure.
proposed_fields_or_change: Present the public entity primarily as Most Significant Change (MSC), with recovery narrative shown as the intended/configured application; add prompts/sampling/panel/verification/consent/feedback fields.
why_deferred: Avoids implying that generic guidance supplies a fixed recovery protocol while preserving the backend canonical identity.

problem: GMB credibility depends on participant/facilitator/script/session/output configuration and representation of disagreement/absent voices.
proposed_fields_or_change: Add a participatory configuration and audit-trail block, with explicit separation of participant-generated causal hypotheses from later empirical/model validation.
why_deferred: Keeps CONFIGURABLE method semantics without inheriting map contents as constructs.

problem: Life-course costing cases mix qualitatively different evidence and economic transformations that need visible provenance.
proposed_fields_or_change: Add a timeline/evidence/cost ledger separating narrative, records, observed/imputed resource use, monetised values and counterfactual/modelled costs.
why_deferred: Prevents individual illustrative cases being read as population average or causal burden estimates.
